description: This file contains implementation details for system information retrieval, including CPU count, CPU frequency, and thread ID functions, with platform-specific code for Windows, Linux, and other systems.

classes.name: UnscaledCycleClockWrapperForInitializeFrequency
classes.description: Wrapper class providing static method to get current cycle clock time.

classes.name: TimeTscPair
classes.description: Structure holding a pair of timestamp and TSC cycle count for frequency measurement.

methods.name: Win32CountSetBits
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set in a bitmask.

methods.name: Win32NumCPUs
methods.description: Retrieves the number of logical CPUs on Windows using system information.

methods.name: GetNumCPUs
methods.description: Determines the number of CPUs based on platform-specific methods.

methods.name: GetNominalCPUFrequency
methods.description: Retrieves the nominal CPU frequency using platform-specific methods.

methods.name: ReadLongFromFile
methods.description: Reads a long integer value from a specified file.

methods.name: ReadMonotonicClockNanos
methods.description: Returns a monotonic timestamp in nanoseconds.

methods.name: GetTimeTscPair
methods.description: Obtains a pair of timestamp and TSC cycle count for frequency measurement.

methods.name: MeasureTscFrequencyWithSleep
methods.description: Measures TSC frequency over a sleep interval.

methods.name: MeasureTscFrequency
methods.description: Estimates TSC frequency by repeated measurements.

methods.name: NumCPUs
methods.description: Returns the number of CPUs, initialized once.

methods.name: NominalCPUFrequency
methods.description: Returns the CPU's nominal frequency, initialized once.

methods.name: GetTID
methods.description: Retrieves the thread ID for various platforms.

methods.name: GetCachedTID
methods.description: Returns cached thread ID to avoid system call overhead.
